title: UE initiated generic transport of NAS messages

entities.name: UE initiated generic transport of NAS messages
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE EMM entity to transport application messages encapsulated in NAS messages. It involves sending an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message containing application data.

entities.name: UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to transport application messages. Contains the generic message container IE and optionally the Additional information IE.

entities.name: generic message container
entities.description: IE that carries the encapsulated application message. Its content, coding and interpretation are application-dependent.

entities.name: generic message container type
entities.description: IE that indicates the application protocol using the generic transport.

entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: Optional IE that carries additional application-requested information. Content, coding and interpretation are application-dependent.

entities.name: UE EMM entity
entities.description: EMM entity in the UE that initiates the generic transport procedure and sends the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: MME EMM entity
entities.description: EMM entity in the MME that receives the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message and provides the contained IEs to the corresponding application.

entities.name: Application request to send message
entities.description: Condition triggered by an application request to send a message encapsulated in the generic transport of NAS message.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message.
The message includes the generic message container IE carrying the application message.
The message includes the generic message container type IE indicating the application protocol.
The message may optionally include the Additional information IE.
The procedure is initiated upon request from an application to send a message.
The UE EMM entity initiates the generic transport procedure.
The MME EMM entity receives the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message and provides its contents to the application.
